description: With data queued on an idle channel, LBT_WAIT_TIMER expiry draws the jitter slot: seed 0 gives slot 15, a contention wait of 45000 ms.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). The S_UNIDATA_REQUEST is priority 0 to SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0, U_PDU "hello"; it asks for no confirmation, so it produces no SIS output (A-0095), and it is data queued for transmission (K-0096). At time 0 the channel has never been busy, so the idle is DCD-determined (K-0073) and the LBT wait is 30000 ms. One csma.jitter draw, uniform(num_cont_slots) = uniform(16) = 15 for seed 0 (prng.md 5), times cont_slot_width_ms 3000. Since corpus 0.7.0 the DTS also keeps dts.ttd at the earliest TTD in its transmit queue: started when a request becomes the earliest, cancelled when the transmit queue empties (C-1050).
